The '''Valveworks''' was the informal name for one of the districts of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], located in the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Nar Shaddaa's Undercity|Undercity]]. They contained a large recycling plant that cleared [[Poison/Legends|toxins]] out of the air. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the plant worked at only 60% capacity, and its owners owed millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]].<ref name="LoNH" />
